attributes.role: Geomatic Engineer | GIS Data Analyst | Generative AI Engineer | Blogger
attributes.personal_statement: A Generative AI Engineer with a Geomatics and Geospatial Information Systems Degree. I am proficient in frontend and backend development, database design, and implementation of machine learning models. I have interacted with, processed, and analyzed geographical data through my degree. My experience with generative AI includes fine-tuning LLMs, prompt engineering, implementing RAG systems, and designing AI-driven chatbots. I am skilled in data engineering where I can collect, store, analyze, and get inferences from data. I am also skilled in machine learning engineering which is an integral part of me as a Generative AI engineer.

attributes.title: Automatic Prompt Generation RAG
attributes.summary: A user interface that can generate well-defined prompts that can be fed into an LLM to give well-structured answers. The interface accepts the user's query then it generates prompts that will enable an LLM to create specific and curated answers.

attributes.title: Redash chatbot add-on
attributes.summary: An LLM-based chatbot for advanced data analytics, visualization, and automated insight extraction.

attributes.title: Scalable Data Warehousing for LLM Fine-tuning
attributes.summary: An API design for high throughput data ingestion and RAG retrieval. This project collects, cleans, processes, and stores text/audio data for the Swahili language. It includes web scraping, database management, API development, and automated workflows to enhance NLP capabilities for the Swahili language.

attributes.summary:
> I am actively training in Generative AI engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, and Data Engineering. I am also learning how to morph well into the job market by incorporating a very important workplace ethos. 
> I am doing this by participating in various real world projects in the mentioned fields and working on various career challenges. 
> The training is very impactful in that I am polishing my skills in the three disciplines and I am able to come up with new ideas on how to solve day-to-day problems through the power of technology.
> The projects I have worked on are;
- Backtesting
- RAG Systems
- Data Analytics
- Technical Report Writing.
- Collaboration, teamwork and communication
- Prompt Tuning
- LLM Fine-tuning
- Causal Inferencing
- Data Warehousing
- Storyboard Synthesis
- LLM Based chatbot design

- I worked on the generation of road maps for the purpose of procurement and/or upgrading.

I did this by;
- Identifying roads for procurement and/or upgrading
- Generating road maps
- Attending Environmental Impact Assessment meetings (ESIA)

The tools I used were;
- ArcMap
- AutoCAD

- The purpose of this activity was to enable the organization to seek funding from the government for upgrading and/or construction of roads under their jurisdiction. The environmental assessment ensured that all construction would be done while adhering to the environmental standards in place.

I worked as a surveyor for the pavement works and extension of the Lanet Airstrip in Nakuru, Kenya.

I did this by;
- Checking runway and taxiway levels
- Comparing construction plan with actual works
- Supervising airstrip construction
- Attending project progress meetings

The tools I used were;
- Automatic level
- Total Station
- Real Time Kinematic (RTK) GPS

-The work I did helped in the tarmacking of the Lanet airstrip and the initialization of the project to add a civilian terminal since the air strip is used by the military alone.
